title: Coinstore Expands into Derivatives, Launching a Million-Dollar futures bonus Campaign
text:
Financial News
Coinstore Expands into Derivatives, Launching a Million-Dollar futures bonus Campaign
As the crypto market shows signs of recovery, activity in the derivatives sector continues to accelerate. Against a backdrop of increasing structural complexity and faster market cycles, Coinstore has initiated a comprehensive expansion of its futures business in Q4 2025. The move follows a series of product iterations and brand upgrades aimed at supporting a wider range of trading strategies and use cases.
Founded in 2020, Coinstore has historically focused on spot trading, serving a global user base and a broad ecosystem of project partners. Over time, the platform has built a solid foundation in both user growth and market depth. On October 15, 2025, Coinstore officially launched its next-generation futures trading system, marking its transition into the “Coinstore 2.0” phase-an operational model that runs spot and derivatives trading in parallel. Futures trading is positioned as one of the platform’s core growth pillars going forward.
At the start of the new year, Coinstore introduced its Futures Bonus on January 6, alongside the launch of the “Million-Dollar Futures Bonus Giveaway.” The campaign is designed to lower the learning curve and reduce trial-and-error costs for users entering derivatives trading. According to the platform, a total of up to 1,000,000 USDT in Futures Bonus will be distributed, allowing participants to trade in real market conditions. The event will last for about 2 months. This event is at the heavyweight level of platform futures promotion in terms of reward scale and activity cycle, bringing users a more impactful experience window.
Over the past two months of iterative development and optimization, Coinstore’s futures product has attracted a stable base of active users and achieved steadily growing trading volumes. Platform data indicates strong engagement following launch, with users citing clear workflows, fast onboarding, and intuitive trading logic as key factors driving adoption.
Alongside product and campaign enhancements, Coinstore has also rolled out an affiliate program targeting content creators, community operators, Web3 enthusiasts, and KOLs. Through long-term commission structures, the program enables partners to convert content influence and community reach into sustainable revenue, supported by dedicated services and ecosystem resources designed to foster long-term collaboration.
How Users Can Earn Rewards
Futures Bonus is an incentive product provided by Coinstore that can be used as a margin for futures positions, as well as to offset trading fees and funding costs. The mechanism allows users to participate in futures trading while reducing upfront capital requirements and effective transaction costs.
The “Million Futures Bonus” campaign is open to both new and existing users, with multiple participation paths covering sign-up rewards, trading competitions, referral incentives, and daily trading activity.
Part 1 | Sign-Up Rewards
Newly registered users can receive between 5 and 10 USDT in Futures Bonus upon completing account registration. The bonus can be used to gain hands-on experience in future trading.
Part 2 | Trading Competition
During the campaign period, Coinstore will allocate a total of 50,000 USDT in subsidies for its futures trading competition. Rewards are distributed based on individual trading performance, with each account eligible to earn more than 1,200 USDT in total rewards.
Part 3 | Referral Incentives
Existing users who invite new users to register, deposit at least 50 USDT, and complete designated futures trading tasks will receive an 80% commission rebate, along with an additional 5 USDT in Futures Bonus.
Participants who complete the required futures trading tasks will also be eligible for a “Super Lucky Draw,” offering cashback rewards of up to 100 USDT.
Part 4 | Daily Trading Rewards
Throughout the campaign, users who participate in daily futures trading can earn up to 30 USDT per day. Specific reward conditions and calculation rules are detailed on the campaign page.
The campaign runs from now until March 6, 2026, at 23:59 (UTC+8). More information on the campaign and participation rules is available through Coinstore’s official announcement.
User-Centric Futures Design
To accommodate users at different stages of trading experience, Coinstore offers both cross-margin and isolated-margin modes. Cross margin allows all available account funds to serve as margin, reducing liquidation risk across positions. Isolated margin, by contrast, assigns margin to individual positions, limiting losses to that position alone in the event of liquidation. For risk management purposes, accounts are set to cross margin by default, with users able to adjust settings as needed.
Leverage options range from 1x to 125x, catering to varying risk preferences. Experienced traders may opt for higher leverage, while new users can begin with lower leverage to familiarize themselves with future mechanics under more controlled conditions.
In terms of product coverage, Coinstore prioritizes high-liquidity, large-cap futures pairs. The platform currently supports major futuress including BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, and SOL/USDT, with plans to expand offerings based on market demand and internal risk assessments.
Futures System 2.0 Upgrade: Balancing Accessibility and Professional Depth.Coinstore officially launched its Futures System 2.0 on October 15, 2025, as a key component of the platform’s Coinstore 2.0 strategy. The new system has undergone a comprehensive infrastructure overhaul focused on trading performance, risk management, and system stability, delivering a significantly enhanced futures trading experience.
Designed to perform reliably even during periods of heightened market volatility, Futures System 2.0 significantly improves matching efficiency and execution stability. Through the introduction of a tiered maintenance margin mechanism and a multi-layered risk management framework, the system strengthens leverage controllability and overall resilience, gradually building a futures trading environment that combines ease of use for newcomers with the depth required by professional traders.
Looking ahead, Coinstore plans to introduce additional features such as unified margin, coin-margined futures, one-click copy trading, and AI-powered analytics. These tools are designed to help users identify traders with strong performance metrics, enabling participation in more mature trading strategies without the need for constant market monitoring.
Market Signals for the New Year
From a timing perspective, the decision to launch the campaign at the beginning of the year is widely seen as Coinstore’s constructive outlook on improving market liquidity in 2026. As macro conditions and market structure continue to evolve, a growing number of traders are once again turning their attention to derivatives-not only as speculative instruments, but as practical tools for hedging, arbitrage, and strategy-based trading.
From an industry standpoint, New Year campaigns remain part of broader user acquisition and engagement strategies across centralized exchanges. However, the underlying incentive logic is shifting. For new users, rewards are increasingly paired with hands-on experience, helping lower the psychological barriers associated with entering futures trading. For active traders, cashback mechanisms and competitive formats directly impact transaction costs and risk–return profiles. Meanwhile, for professional and quantitative participants, transparent rules and clearly defined calculation models have become key determinants of whether an incentive program is worth engaging with at all.
Coinstore Founder Johnson stated that simplifying trading and strengthening asset security have always been core principles guiding Coinstore’s product development. He noted that through continuous product iteration, the platform aims to improve usability and lower participation barriers, enabling more users to take part in the development of the crypto ecosystem. At the same time, Coinstore continues to upgrade its underlying technology to enhance asset security. For centralized exchanges, asset protection remains the most fundamental responsibility. Looking ahead, Coinstore will continue to expand its offerings across Futures, spot, and structured products, focusing on mechanisms designed to support long-term user experience rather than relying on short-term incentives.

With over 10 million users worldwide, more than 1,100 listed tokens including 100+ premium digital assets. Coinstore is dedicated to providing secure, professional, and accessible digital asset trading services.
